thread:
Nadia Ibrahim: Cedarworks onboarding quick check. Two items blocking daytime cutover: audit log destination format & KMS rotation policy. Can we finalize today?

Owen Park: Do we have their audit-forwarder endpoint and the expected JSON schema? If not ask them for a doc.

Nadia Ibrahim: They gave a sample JSONL (single line per event). Pasting here:
```json
{"tenant":"cedarworks","ts":"2026-03-21T11:45:00Z","event_type":"inference_response","model":"rwd-13b","req_len":128,"lat_ms":110,"redacted":true}
```

Tina Hall: KMS: They require that the CMK be customer-owned with rotation every 180 days, managed by their security team. They specifically state: "Redwood must never be a key administrator."

Nadia Ibrahim: Noted. They allow our service principal to use the key for crypto operations but not modify policies. Also they asked for audit logs to contain tenant + request_id + trace_id.

infra-bot: onboarding checklist updated by Owen Park: added "audit-jsonl-tenant-trace" and "customer-cmk-180d".

Owen Park: Network note: They have an egress-only firewall and will accept logs via HTTPS on port 443 to their collector. They require client cert authentication. We need cert exchange.

Tina Hall: I'll coordinate cert fingerprints with their security contact. Also adding a runbook step for cert rotation every 90 days so our cert TTL aligns with their policy.

sec-bot: Security reminders: - Remove PII before logging. - Enforce masking. - KMS policy must limit Admin actions to Cedarworks account. - Ensure TLS client auth is configured in the forwarder step.

Nadia Ibrahim: Scheduling a 10-min call at 14:00 PT to confirm cert exchange and finalize KMS ARN. Invite sent.

Owen Park: After call I'll update the runbook and post the diff.

Nadia Ibrahim: Thanks team. Will close blockers after they send the CMK ARN and confirm the cert fingerprint.
